customSections.label: What Round Rock ISD Families Should Know
customSections.content: RRISD uses several district-specific labels that are easy to miss on the PDF. September 21 includes Yom Kippur, October 19 and February 15 are labeled YOU Days, and March 10 includes Eid al-Fitr. RRISD uses YOU Days as district closure days under its YOU well-being program. October 12 also includes elementary conferences; families should check their elementary school's calendar for conference details.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2025–26
customSections.content: The 2026–27 calendar starts and ends later than the prior school year and lists one fewer instructional day.

groups.label: First and last days
items: School starts August 19, one week later than in 2025–26. The last day moves from May 21 to May 27.

groups.label: Instructional-day total
items: The official total changes from 171 instructional days in 2025–26 to 170 in 2026–27.

groups.label: Diwali
items: Diwali was listed as a student and staff holiday in 2025–26. It does not appear on the official 2026–27 calendar; October 19 is labeled Student & Staff Holiday / YOU Day.

customSections.label: School Assignment and Attendance Boundaries
customSections.content: Round Rock ISD serves parts of Round Rock, Austin, and Cedar Park across Williamson and Travis counties. City names and ZIP codes do not always match district boundaries, so families should use Round Rock ISD's official boundary map to confirm their assigned elementary, middle, and high schools before enrollment or a move.

breaksTitle: Major Breaks and Student Return Dates

breakNotes.Fall Break: With the weekends on either side, students are off for nine straight days. Classes resume Monday, November 30.
breakNotes.Winter Break: Official Winter Break runs December 21–January 1. Students are also off December 18 and January 4, so they have no classes from December 18 through January 4. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5.
breakNotes.Spring Break: With the weekends on either side, students are off for nine straight days. Classes resume Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Round Rock ISD start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Round Rock ISD students is Wednesday, August 19, 2026. Staff development and preparation days begin before students return.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Round Rock ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of classes is Thursday, May 27, 2027. The second semester also ends that day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Round Rock ISD Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Official Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students are also off December 18 for a teacher work day and January 4 for staff development, so they return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Round Rock ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Round Rock ISD have a Fall Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Fall Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Round Rock ISD 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Round Rock ISD lists 170 instructional days for 2026–27, based on a 440-minute school day.

calendarNotes: This page covers Round Rock ISD's districtwide 2026–27 calendar. It preserves the official labels that affect student attendance and explains the difference between the published Winter Break and the additional student days off. Campus events, bell schedules, and later district changes should be confirmed with RRISD.
allDatesDerivedDateNote: Planning date derived from the published district calendar; it is not a separately named event in the PDF's event list.
sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026, against Round Rock ISD's official calendar page and 2026–27 district calendar PDF, updated February 4, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF footer identifies the source version as Updated 02-04-2026.
The official PDF lists August 19, 2026, as the first day for students and May 27, 2027, as the last day.
The calendar lists 170 instructional days based on a 440-minute school day.
Official event labels were retained for Yom Kippur, Indigenous Peoples' Day / Columbus Day, YOU Days, and Eid al-Fitr rather than being reduced to generic no-school labels.
The published Winter Break is December 21–January 1. Separate student holidays on December 18 and January 4 mean students have no classes through January 4, with classes resuming January 5.
